mentions.description: An AI-native browser where WebMCP is a first-class feature and a built-in in-app agent uses it to complete tasks, rather than being a bolt-on chat sidebar; MCP actions execute quickly, and the author drives it through their Hermes agent.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on a AI native browser = WebMCP is first class and the in-app agent uses it to do tasks.. not the same as a slapped on chat sidebar. also MCP actions are lightning fast.. so i use it via my Hermes agent.
